trace.notes: Normalized input as zbMATH record 7001181. Direct zbMATH web fetch returned a 403 Cloudflare challenge; the zbMATH REST API /v1/document/7001181 returned resolver metadata identifying DOI 10.1080/17476933.2017.1414806, but not readable full text.

Crossref confirmed the exact title, author, DOI, journal, pages 64-67, and Taylor & Francis full/PDF links. The DOI landing page redirected to Taylor & Francis, and local fetching of Taylor & Francis returned a 403 Cloudflare challenge. OpenAlex reported is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.

Bounded exact-work recovery used exact DOI/title searches, including exact title plus PDF and exact title plus problem terms. Inspected candidates were Taylor & Francis DOI/PDF pages, EurekaMag metadata, zbMATH author/profile metadata, and IMAR CV/report references; they were metadata-only, abstract-only, citation-only, blocked/paywalled, or different follow-up works rather than a readable exact-work full-text artifact.
